annotation.title_clean: D1.2 Ethics Framework: Managing active and healthy aging with use of caring service robots (MARIO)
annotation.title_en: D1.2 Ethics Framework: Managing active and healthy aging with use of caring service robots (MARIO)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Beyan, T.; Felzmann, H.; Ryan, M.; Lang, N.; Beyan, O.
annotation.venue: MARIO project (H2020 643808) deliverable; University of Twente research portal
annotation.summary_en: Ethics framework deliverable for the EU H2020 MARIO project on care robots for older people with dementia. It reviews the literature and develops a multi-layered ethical analysis covering care roles, quality of care, robot functions and design features. It then applies this to MARIO use cases, with attention to privacy and data protection.
key_provisions_or_claims: Multi-layered framework: care process integration, quality of care, robotic functionalities, core capabilities and design features
Care robots are double-edged, with potential for both ethical infringements and improvements
Humanoid design should be permitted only as far as needed for reasonable design objectives
Privacy and data protection concerns are integrated into the design process
Framework is applied to dementia-care MARIO use case scenarios, including research ethics and informed consent
